faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MGU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the MGU Project Assistant post is 14 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Assistant position in the Mahatma Gandhi University recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for MGU Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The application mode for the MGU Project Assistant recruitment is Email. Interested candidates need to send their applications to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Assistant post at MGU?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Assistant position at MGU will receive a salary of Rs 27,000/- per month, along with HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc in Chemistry with a minimum of 60% marks. Preference will be given to candidates who have qualified GATE/NET examinations.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MGU Project Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the MGU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Project Assistant at MGU?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position at Mahatma Gandhi University will primarily involve an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Assistant post is Kottayam, Kerala, with the pincode 686560, as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this MGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the MGU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 is PVS/SCS-ANRF-PMECRG/2026-27/1. This number helps in identifying the specific notification.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with GATE/NET scores get preference?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have successfully passed the GATE or NET examinations will be given preference during the selection process for the Project Assistant post at MGU.
